description.en: Attacks an enemy and has a <color=#28d9ed>70%</color> chance to inflict <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>2 turn(s)</color>. (Ignores Resilience)
description.jp: 敵単体にダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>70%</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>を<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>の間付与する。(効果抵抗無視)
description.kr: 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>70%</color> 확률로 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 동안 부여합니다. (효과 저항 무시)
description.zh: 攻击敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>70%</color>的几率对目标造成<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。(无视效果抵抗)

description.en:
(Passive Effect) At the start of battle, inflicts irremovable <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color> on the fastest enemy for <color=#28d9ed>2 turns</color>. (Ignores Resilience)
Additionally, grants <color=#28d9ed>Pureblood's Domain</color> to all allies.

Allies' Bleeding DMG increases by <color=#28d9ed>50%</color>.

(Active Effect) Attacks all enemies and with a <color=#28d9ed>80%</color> chance, inflicts <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color> on the target for <color=#28d9ed>2 turns</color>. (Ignores Resilience)
description.jp:
(パッシブ効果) 戦闘開始時、最もスピードが速い敵単体に解除されない<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>を<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>の間付与する。（効果抵抗無視）
さらに味方全体に<color=#28d9ed>【鮮血の領域】</color>を付与する。

味方の出血ダメージが<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>UPする。

(アクティブ効果) 敵全体にダメージを与え、<color=#28d9ed>80%</color>の確率で対象に<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>を<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>の間付与する。（効果抵抗無視）
description.kr:
(패시브 효과) 전투 시작 시 속도가 가장 빠른 적 한 명에게 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 동안 해제되지 않는 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 부여합니다. (효과 저항 무시)
추가로 아군 전체에게 <color=#28d9ed>선혈의 영역</color>을 부여합니다.

아군의 출혈 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 증가합니다.

(액티브 효과) 적 전체를 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>80%</color> 확률로 대상에게 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 동안 부여합니다. (효과 저항 무시)
description.zh:
(被动效果) 战斗开始时，对速度最快的敌人1名附加<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>无法解除的<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>。（无视效果抵抗）
追加对我方全体附加<color=#28d9ed>鲜血领域</color>。

我方出血伤害增加<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>。

(主动效果) 攻击全体敌人，以<color=#28d9ed>80%</color>的概率对目标附加<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>的<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>。（无视效果抵抗）

description.en: When using this skill, removes <color=#28d9ed>1</color> <color=#28d9ed>buff(s)</color> from all enemies and attacks all enemies. If the target is <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color> , DMG increases by <color=#28d9ed>50%</color>. After using the skill, decreases the target's <color=#28d9ed>Defense</color> for <color=#28d9ed>3 turns</color>. (Ignores Resilience)
description.jp: スキル使用時、敵全体の<color=#28d9ed>強化効果</color>を<color=#28d9ed>1個</color>解除し、敵全体にダメージを与える。対象が<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状態の場合、ダメージが<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>UPし、スキル使用後<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>を<color=#28d9ed>3ターン</color>の間DOWNさせる。（効果抵抗無視）
description.kr: 스킬 사용 시 적 전체의 <color=#28d9ed>강화 효과</color>를 <color=#28d9ed>1개</color> 해제하고 적 전체를 공격합니다. 대상이 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color> 상태라면 피해가 <color=#28d9ed>50%</color> 증가하고 스킬 사용 후 <color=#28d9ed>방어력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>3턴</color> 동안 감소시킵니다. (효과 저항 무시)
description.zh: 使用技能时，解除全体敌人<color=#28d9ed>1个</color><color=#28d9ed>强化效果</color>并攻击全体敌人。若目标处于<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>状态，伤害增加<color=#28d9ed>50%</color>，技能使用后使目标<color=#28d9ed>防御力</color>在<color=#28d9ed>3回合</color>内减少。（无视效果抵抗）

name.jp: イプシロンの身体強化Ⅱ

description.en: (Passive Effect)\nIncreases <color=#28d9ed>Penetration</color> and <color=#28d9ed>damage</color> by <color=#28d9ed>5%</color> and <color=#28d9ed>3%</color> respectively, when gaining a turn. (Max 10 stacks)
description.jp: (パッシブ効果)\nターン開始時、自分の<color=#28d9ed>貫通力</color>が<color=#28d9ed>5%</color>、<color=#28d9ed>与えるダメージ</color>が<color=#28d9ed>3%</color>UPする。\n(最大10回まで累積)
description.kr: (패시브 효과)\n턴 획득 시, <color=#28d9ed>관통력, 피해량</color>이 <color=#28d9ed>5%, 3%</color> 증가합니다.(최대 10회 누적)
description.zh: (被动效果)\n获得回合时，<color=#28d9ed>穿透力、伤害量</color>分别提升<color=#28d9ed>5%，3%</color>。(最多可叠加10次)

description.en:
Becomes <color=#28d9ed>Enraged</color> when Health drops to <color=#28d9ed>70%</color> of Max Health or lower, then immediately uses <color=#28d9ed>Sword of Pure Blood</color>.

This attacks all enemies and has a <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> chance to inflict two <color=#28d9ed>Bleeding</color> effects for <color=#28d9ed>2 turns</color>.
Then grants all allies except for the caster irremovable increased <color=#28d9ed>Defense, Attack</color>, and <color=#28d9ed>Speed</color> for <color=#28d9ed>5 turns</color> while <color=#28d9ed>healing</color> by <color=#28d9ed>20%</color>.
description.jp:
最大HPの<color=#28d9ed>70%</color>以下になると<color=#28d9ed>【狂暴化】</color>状態に切り替わり、<color=#28d9ed>【鮮血の剣】</color>を直ちに発動する。

この攻撃は敵全体にダメージを与え、対象に<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>の確率で<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>2個を<color=#28d9ed>2ターン</color>の間付与する。
その後、自分を除く味方全体の<color=#28d9ed>防御力、攻撃力、スピード</color>を<color=#28d9ed>5ターン</color>の間UPさせ、<color=#28d9ed>HP</color>を<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>回復させる。(解除不可)
description.kr:
최대 체력의 <color=#28d9ed>70%</color> 이하가 되면 <color=#28d9ed>광폭화</color> 상태로 전환하고, <color=#28d9ed>선혈의 검</color> 을 즉시 사용합니다.

이 공격은 전체 적을 공격하고 <color=#28d9ed>100%</color> 확률로 대상에게 2개의 <color=#28d9ed>출혈</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>2턴</color> 동안 부여합니다.
이 후, 자신을 제외한 아군 전체에게 해제되지 않는 <color=#28d9ed>방어력, 공격력, 속도</color> 증가 효과를 <color=#28d9ed>5턴</color> 동안 부여하며 추가로 <color=#28d9ed>체력</color>을 <color=#28d9ed>20%</color> 회복시킵니다.
description.zh:
若生命值降至上限的<color=#28d9ed>70%</color>以下，则转换为<color=#28d9ed>狂暴化</color>状态，并立即发动<color=#28d9ed>鲜血之剑</color>。

该攻击会攻击全体敌人，并有<color=#28d9ed>100%</color>的几率对目标造成2个<color=#28d9ed>出血</color>效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>2回合</color>。
此后，使除自身外全体友军获得无法被解除的<color=#28d9ed>防御力、攻击力、速度</color>提升效果，持续<color=#28d9ed>5回合</color>，并额外使<color=#28d9ed>生命值</color>恢复<color=#28d9ed>20%</color>。
